items.text: A pane the window presenter is not composing no longer stalls 40ms per frame and drops it.
A pane without its own layer now shows background along its growing edge during a divider drag.
A relative XDG_CONFIG_HOME no longer crashes the app at launch.
The focus glow fade is filmed on screen, and a pane focused from the CLI in a background window now takes the glow.
A busy light's ring is drawn over the focus glow on the compositor, as the window draws it.
